dependencies.baseline-browser-mapping: Pinned browser-baseline data consumed transitively by the Vite/Browserslist toolchain rather than imported by application source.
dependencies.postcss: Build-tool engine used by Vite/Tailwind through postcss.config.cjs rather than imported directly.
dependencies.shadcn: Manual component-scaffolding CLI configured by components.json; it is intentionally not part of runtime imports or package scripts.
dependencies.@testing-library/dom: Required peer dependency of @testing-library/react; consumed through the React Testing Library adapter rather than imported directly.
